Analysis of a singe-marked wide drakewood keg indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~~Portable Keg~~

This is a portable keg-type item that pours a drink!  Anyone can pour from a keg that's on the ground or an applicable surface; only you can pour from it when it is PLACEd alongside you.  POUR produces a drink; POUR keg IN <container> can fill a *generic* drink container.

When you put the keg on the ground, only you will be able to pick it up for the following 2 ["real time"] hours.  When the timer expires: it will auto-move to your "alongside" inventory if you are in the same room; otherwise, if you are logged in, it will message you.  Logging out does NOT stop the timer.  If left on the ground post-timer expiration, anyone can pick it up, including the janitor.
Verbs & messaging:
-Standard: POUR, GET, DROP, CLEAN (empties keg), MEASURE, HUG, KICK, PUSH
-Still-Created: LEAN, POUND, TWIST

This keg will dispense "a tumbler of fiery gold tequila" and has 23 pours remaining.  Some merchants may be able to refill or add pours to your keg, though it will max out at 50 total pours.  Some unlocked Stills can provide refills.

Alterations to the keg's aesthetics are allowed -- they must make sense for a closed-lid container built to dispense drinks via a tap w/ lever.  Generally it is a "keg".  The "read"/language is alterable but not permanent - it will be overwritten if the keg is auto-filled with a new drink.  Changing the drink inside requires use of an applicable Still and/or a qualified merchant.
You might be able to have a talented merchant lighten the keg, limited to once per session.
The wide drakewood keg will cost 9,000,000 coins.

items.name: a silver bracelet of alternating polished and matte segments

raw: Analysis of a silver bracelet of alternating polished and matte segments indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This bracelet is for perfume or cologne.  Current verbs are: DRINK, MEASURE, POUR, and SMELL.
This bracelet currently has no scent.
This scent is NOT eligible for permanence.
OVERVIEW

Hello there, intrepid adventurer!  This silver bracelet is an auto-perfume item!  These items automatically refresh perfumes when they expire, allowing you to always smell your best!  Perfume and colognes are stored in small vials and are dispensed via a small mechanism, so the item must support that intent (e.g. typically with a pendant or small charm).
VERBS
POUR bracelet ON Brodega - apply the currently active scent to yourself.
POUR {bottle} INTO bracelet - pour a bottle into the bracelet to add charges.
TURN - Move to the next vial.
FLIP - Empty a vial (requires confirmation).
PEER - List scents contained in the bracelet.
SPIN - Select a random vial (Requires Tier 2).
TINKER - Toggle randomization for auto-application (Requires Tier 2).
FIDGET - Toggle permanence for adding scents (Requires Tier 3).
POINT - Refresh the perfume of your corpse (Requires Tier 3).
RP Verbs - RAISE, WAVE, TILT, RUB, SLAP, and CONSIDER
TIERING
Tier 1 - Baseline item that will autorefresh a scent when it expires.
Tier 2 - Allows for the scent to be randomly chosen when refreshing.
Tier 3 - Bottomless scents may be added to the bracelet, destroying the originating bottle.  Unlocks POINT, which refreshes the scent on your corpse.
Tier 4 - All scents added are permanent, even if the originating bottle was not.
RP Verbs - Add 6 RP verbs: RAISE, WAVE, TILT, RUB, SLAP, and CONSIDER.
This bracelet is Tier 3 of 4.  RP verbs are unlocked.  It currently has 10 vials out of a maximum of 10.
ALTERING
This item may be freely altered but must be substantial enough to hold a small mechanism with 1-10 small vials attached to it.
The silver bracelet will cost 15,000,000 coins.

It is estimated that a jet black spidersilk cloak edged with silver silk trim can store a significant amount with enough space for any number of items.
Analysis of a jet black spidersilk cloak edged with silver silk trim indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a classic spidersilk cloak.  You can try to WEAR, REMOVE, CLEAN, OPEN, and CLOSE your cloak.  You can try to TICKLE, TAP, LISTEN, and COVER your cloak's spider-shaped clasp.  Note that the cloak does attune to the wearer.
To clear attunement, RAISE the cloak and follow the given instructions.
This cloak can be altered on rare occasions -- it is considered a special merchant service and is not a GALD service.

[In the rare case that you are given a chance to alter the cloak, you will usually have some say in the main color of the cloak, the cloak's accent (generally this is the trim), the wording of the webbing ("web-draped" and "cobweb-covered" are the two examples to follow), and the first 15 of the spider-shaped clasp.  In some cases, not all of the options may be available for alteration, and there are some additional restrictions when the main color of the cloak will end up as "white" or "dark blue".]
The spidersilk cloak will cost 10,000,000 coins.
It is estimated to be worth about 100,000 silvers.
It is a container with a maximum interior capacity of 100 pounds with room for any number of items.
It is predominantly crafted of cloth.
It has a permanently unlocked loresong by Demid.

The leather harness is composed of several straps, some lined with a row of slots for smaller bladed weapons or wands, while a series of straps lines the backing.  Hanging from the harness are large sacks, narrow tubes, small pouches, and containers.
It is estimated that a frayed leather harness can store a medium amount with enough space for any number of items.
Analysis of a frayed leather harness indicates the creator has provided the following information:
The leather harness is unlocked, but not fully unlocked.  It has 8 verbs.

When altering, keep in mind that the harness's messaging references large and small containers, and a row of weapon slots and straps.  These can all be altered by a skilled merchant.  The containers should remain plural.  Currently, they are set to slots (wands and small weapons), straps (belted weapons), a series of straps (back weapons), large sacks (bundled weapons), narrow tubes (paper and scrolls), small pouches (trinkets), and containers (anything else).
The leather harness will cost 3,500,000 coins.

raw: Analysis of a sinuous diamondback rattlesnake indicates the creator has provided the following information:
This is a wearable, poseable snake.  When worn, it parks itself in your UNIQUE feature field.
This particular snake currently looks like this:
a sinuous diamondback rattlesnake

The snake's description can be altered by any merchant who feels comfortable doing so.  Remember: this snake must remain some form of non-legged, scale-having serpent.  It must be large enough in its natural form to encircle a being's waist, while not being so large that it makes no sense to twine around a forearm.  Any naturally occurring snake from the real world is fine, so long as the name doesn't violate any other GS Policy guidelines.  Dyes (as from the alchemy or cobbling systems) may not be used to make these snakes glow, shimmer, sparkle, or anything of the sort.
This diamondback rattlesnake is Tier 1, which is off the shelf level.  Verbs are: Mumble, Wear, Remove, and Rub.

These snakes are only able to be worn for a limited amount of time before they become too uncomfortable and slither down into your hands.  If you remove them manually before that point, you're fine, but if they get to the point of exhaustion, there will be a one hour cooldown while it rests up before it may be worn again.
This diamondback rattlesnake may be worn for about 25 minutes before becoming exhausted and entering cooldown mode.
The diamondback rattlesnake will cost 5,000,000 coins.

--------- TIU & QAITEKE LIZARD SADDLES - ANALYZE INFO  ---------
This nakaten is a Tiu & Qaiteke saddle meant for use with "lizard" mounts.
Verb Sets active on this nakaten:
*Verb Set 1:  DROP/PUT, GET, MOUNT (with styles), and DISMOUNT (with styles).
MOUNT styles -- MOUNT {STYLE} {target lizard} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are:  RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
DISMOUNT styles -- DISMOUNT {STYLE} -- that are valid for this nakaten's current setup are: RIGHT, LEFT, JUMP, SLIDE, LEG, CROUCH, BATTLECRY
--------- ALTERATION INFORMATION ---------

The noun cannot change.  So what can you do?  Any merchant may alter the article, adjective, and/or long description of the nakaten.  They can also add a show description that will append to the hard-coded LOOK.  All alterations must be in keeping with the saddle's style (see below).  It is also recommended that you avoid show descriptions that rely on the long description for future-forward accessory use that temporarily changes the long description.

Note that some aspects of the LOOK are hard-coded (such as the length of the stirrups) and cannot currently be modified by a merchant.  Currently, the pommel ring is set up as double, which CAN be swapped out (between single and double) by willing merchants.

This saddle's style (which is not currently eligible to be changed to another style) is set to nakaten (Tehir).  For alteration purposes, keep the following in mind:  It has a flat, wide seat, a minimal pommel, and no gullet.  Instead of a horn, it has a "pommel ring(s)" -- either a single upright ring or double outward angled rings that jut out from the pommel area.  It has a high, back-angled cantle with a fantail.  The strap system includes forward and rear girth straps that connect via the legs and front of the chest.  Saddle blanket ("nakatela" in Tehir) use is common, and pads are never used.  It is heavy compared to other saddle styles.

raw: The mechanism inside of the box looks like it is set up to work with any form of magical scroll to make it look like a cream-colored scroll smeared with mulberry jam-colored stains.

Analysis of a cream-colored box smeared with mulberry jam-colored stains indicates the creator has provided the following information:

As you look over the box, you realize that it would be quite easy for any merchant to work on the aesthetics of the item, so long as it remains a box of some kind that can reasonably fit a scroll and the cutting mechanism in it (which cannot be removed).

You also get the distinct impression that any merchant can change the design that the box makes on scrolls.  Generally, such designs might include the color, texture, shape, and general adornment (such as red-stamped or black-inked). Thus, if the merchant is willing, he or she can customize the design of the article, adjective, and/or long description of the scroll that you wish to produce.

Currently, you are able to put a magical scroll in the box and PUSH it to cut the scroll.  You can also TURN the box to change how certain scroll types are cut.  LOOK at it to get an idea of what the design will come out like, bearing in mind that the noun will always be the same noun that you put into the box.
This portable scroll-cutter currently has 25 charges left for use.  For any box under 150 charges, any willing merchant can add 100 extra charges for 45,000 silvers total.
The cream-colored box will cost 2,000,000 coins.

This item may be altered under the following conditions: the gemcutter's form must be something humanoid with a back, a head, and an appendage that can hold something, like a hand, a claw, or paw.  It must be made of metal.

Only certain patterns made specifically for gemcutters can be used with this item.

Preserved under a purple-tinted lacquer, the haon device is accented with silver toggles, gears, buttons, and levers.  Glass rods are visible within a window that takes up the entire left side, the uppermost one completely clear.  A small door on the back has a flashing dull circle of amber over it, while a nearby window flashes with the number "0."  Another window, next to a small knob, has a readout of the word "paint" within its oblong frame.  Attached to the bottom of the device is a simple sterling silver plaque affixed to its side that is bound in place with silver screws and has crisp lettering engraved into its smooth face proclaiming, "~*~ The Paint-in-ator 3000 ~*~."

Attached to the bottom of the device is a simple  plaque affixed to its side that is bound in place with  screws and has crisp lettering engraved into its smooth face proclaiming "~*~ The Paint-in-ator 3000 ~*~".
Analysis of a dark-banded haon device indicates the creator has provided the following information:
Welcome to the one, the only, and the never-before-seen "Paint-in-ator 3000"!

This incredible, amazing, and often underestimated item will thrill you with its ability to store paint.  That's right, Brodega!  It stores paint!  If you aren't sure what to do with paint, then you clearly do not understand the physical strain of a crafter!
Instructions:
1. Hold your paint in hand
2. POUR your paint IN the Paint-in-ator 3000
3. Marvel at the relief to your shoulders as you shed weight
4. GAZE at your Paint-in-ator 3000 to see all the stored paints
Retrieval Instructions:
1. PUSH a crystal amulet (or any of its cousins) into the Paint-in-ator.  (she's a hungry beast!)
2. TAP the Paint-in-ator to determine how many doses you want to retrieve (options: 1 - 5)
3. SPIN the Paint-in-ator to cycle through all the stored paint (50 is max)
4. TURN the Paint-in-ator to collect your paint
Please note, any paints poured into the "Paint-in-ator 3000" are consumed by it and can only be retrieved using the methods listed above.
That's right, Brodega, it is that simple!
But wait!  There's more!  If you aren't satisfied with the plain, the boring, or the OFF-the-SHELF Paint-in-ator, then you can obtain an UNLOCK certificate for better convenience and goodness!

The Paint-in-ator has the following commands: gaze (displays all stored paint), pour (adds paint to device), pull (removes crystal amulet from device), push (adds crystal amulet to device), spin (cycles through available paint), tap (cycles through doses to create), and turn (provides paint)
The "Paint-in-ator 3000" is Tier 1 (OTS) of 2.

Altering Instructions:  The Paint-in-ator must always be a box of some kind and must always be belt-worn.  Due to its complicated (patent pending) dials, chambers, switches, and toggles, it can never support a SHOW DESCRIPTION, but it can handle long descriptions.

Disclaimers:  The Paint-in-ator is a sensitive device and as such its creators wish to remind you that it is made for good fun.  As a result, it has restrictions on it to prevent the harm of small children and animals.  The creators do not want any accusations of "The Paint-in-ator ate my baby!"  Please be sure to always use the Paint-in-ator appropriately.  Drinking while using the Paint-in-ator forfeits all warranties, guarantees, and most lacquers.  Do not place your hands in the device while it is in use, as the creators will not be held responsible for missing digits.  And, for the love of all that is holy, do not bring a knife anywhere near it.  Do not use in the bath, as the creators will not be held responsible for what may happen.  For your safety, do not break these rules.

Lacquer: purple-tinted
Device Material: haon
Metal Plate: sterling silver

raw: Analysis of some gold-dusted turquoise blue macaw filoplumes indicates the creator has provided the following information:
As you contemplate some gold-dusted turquoise blue macaw filoplumes you realize that it is a small item and will never have much weight to it, therefore lightening it seems unnecessary.
You also note that certain parts of the filoplumes translate into the color of beads, haircombs, and headbands.  Currently, that is gold.
This filoplumes is an off the shelf model (tier 0 of 4 tiers or OTS).  You are able to use the following verbs on it:  wear, remove, weave*, pull**, and attend.
Those verbs marked with * mean that they will create a hairstyle, and if it is marked with ** it will either remove the hairstyle or tell you what your current hairstyle looks like.

Even though the noun may be a type of feather, all hairstyles have pre-arranged ways that they will be displayed and your noun may not ever show in the hairstyle.  All feather types are allowed for the noun.

When getting these altered, feel free to express to the merchant the following information: "I would like to get the beads/haircombs/headband material/color changed to X Y Z, and I'd like to get the color/avian feather changed to A B C.
Any merchant that is comfortable with this item may unlock it to tier 2.
Lastly, the filoplumes does not require you to be wearing a hairstyle for its verbs to work.  It can be worn with other hair items and still manipulated, the same as the hair baubles.
The blue macaw filoplumes will cost 30,000 coins.

Also note that death automatically ousts the disguise from a character.

The necklet is set up to place the following aesthetic attributes on a character.  Altering these settings may only be done on rare occasions by qualified persons; it is not a general merchant service.
Race: Sylvankind
Currently you are able to try to PUSH (to activate), PULL (to deactivate), LICK, and RUB (toggles item's visibility while active) the necklet.

Aesthetic alterations to the item itself are acceptable -- they just must make sense for where the item is worn.  Note that needles come out of the underside of the item, so nothing in the alteration should prevent that from logically occurring.

PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.

Scarring Others:

items.name: a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork

raw: The yoke is constructed of layers of carmine brocade and looks like it will span the shoulders and taper down the front of the torso.  Four rows of four faceted glyphs form the yoke's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  At the moment, all of the glyphs appear dull and lifeless.
It is estimated that a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork can store a small amount with enough space for a couple of items.
Analysis of a carmine glyph-adorned yoke trimmed with ivory beadwork indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the yoke and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/glyph-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "glyph-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the yoke refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the yoke CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the glyph-adorned yoke, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a small statue.
This is a Tier 1 yoke, with four tiers in total.  This yoke is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Glyph Adorned Baldric
This yoke CANNOT be deepened at all.
The glyph-adorned yoke will cost 175,000 coins.

Analysis of a tightly braided staff of slender mistwood crowned with an opulent diamond pegasus indicates the creator has provided the following information:
~*~ Nervestaves ~*~
SCRIPT DETAILS
The staff has a mechanical (combat) script which provides three basic types of functionality that can be broken down into the following categories:

AFFINITY - A special, custom 'bonding' like mechanism.  Any given item can share an Affinity with only one person at a time.  Affinity is gained by wielding the item and landing successful hits against like level foes.

BACKLASH - Potential negative effects, including immobilization, stuns, and nervous system damage, that can occur at random.  As the wielder's Affinity with the item grows, the chance of a Backlash occurring are reduced.

FLARES   - Off-the-Shelf, this item comes with a 'Muscle Memory' flare that, when triggered, will temporarily enhance the wielder's Combat Maneuver Ranks.  The magnitude of the enhancement is based on the degree of Affinity shared with the wielder, while the frequency of the flare is determined by the item's tier.

Unlocked items also possess the potential for an offensive 'Misery Unleashed' flare.  This flare can ONLY be triggered when the item is wielded against like level foes by someone with whom a COMPLETE Affinity is shared.
ITEM DETAILS

This is a tiered item that is currently Tier 2 of 4, which results in a 25% chance for the Muscle Memory flare to trigger when used against like level foes.  It also has the following verbs available:  CLENCH, TOUCH, and STARE.

The braided staff shares a considerable Affinity with someone, but it isn't with you!  This will result in a bonus of 5 to Combat Maneuver Ranks being applied when the Muscle Memory flare is successfully triggered.
Using this item in combat against like level foes will decrease the Affinity Level.

items.name: a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome

raw: The brass and gold capsule is divided into two halves, with the top portion being crafted from glass and the bottom portion wrought from brass and gold.  Through the transparent glass, ten chambers are exposed inside the capsule, each detailed with a miniature replica of the cities and towns across Elanthia.  A glowing ring surrounds the chamber for River's Rest currently.  It appears that the capsule can hold 20 Chronomage spheres in each chamber.  An enruned opening is situated between both halves of the capsule.  The brass and gold capsule contains 6 brass and gold spheres in the River's Rest chamber.
The capsule can not be worn.
Analysis of a brass and gold capsule with a glass dome indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is a container to hold your Chronomage spheres.  The spheres must NOT be attuned to you, used in a waiting room, or have an expirations.  This capsule holds 20 spheres in each chamber.  This can be expanded to hold more by special vouchers or rare merchants that will dabble in such arts.
Usage:
LOOK at MY capsule            - Look at the chambers inside.
PUT {sphere} [in] MY capsule  - Insert a sphere inside the proper chamber.
PUSH MY capsule               - Eject a sphere from inside the capsule.
TURN MY capsule               - Change which chamber it is set to.
RUB MY capsule                - Reveal the contents of each chamber instantly.
The brass and gold capsule will cost 500,000 coins.

~*~ Moth Cloaks ~*~

This cloak is a butterfly/moth cloak with several randomizing points to create multiple unique looks with a single PUSH.  It is Tier 5 out of 5, and it is set to the moth setting.  It is set to rotate with day/night changes.  You can APPROVE to toggle this setting.
The cloak features an encumbrance reduction (3x/day, 15 minutes each RUB, resets at midnight server time.  There are 3 charges left today.
Utilities:
* APPROVE:  rotates through "moth only," "butterfly only," or "adjust with day/night"
* CLEAN:  will clear the selected, stored look
* POKE: takes your randomized look and saves it in 1 of the 2 available stored slots
* PUSH - replaces your randomized look
* TURN - rotates through all saved looks (current randomized look, any stored randomized looks, the custom look, if applicable)
* RUB - activates the encumbrance reduction.
Unlocked Fluff Verbs:  observe, tickle, eat, flip, hug, raise, bow, curtsy, brush, touch, and wave
*  WAVE has some "drama llama" options for you!  Try WAVE CLOAK WITH (anger, drama, joy, mystery, or sorrow)
Alterations:
* Base:  must be simple, as it carries across all looks.  The noun must be in the hooded cloak family.
* Material:  must be a type of cloth.  This carries across all looks.
* Colors cannot be referenced in the base or material fields, as colors change based on the settings.
* Custom settings:  The alter points must be provided in this specific order:

** "butterfly adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing markinglocation^special*moth adjective^wingtype^forewing color^forewing marking^forewing marking color^forewing marking location^hindwing color^hindwing marking^hinding marking color^hindwing marking location^special
** The total character count must be 511 or less
** Moth/Butterfly Adjective alter point must be 15 characters or less.  No a/an needed.
** See the wiki for in-depth information and examples at https://gswiki.play.net/Moth_Cloak
* Custom Look 1 (Butterfly):  You can provide a SHOW for your custom setting.  It cannot contradict the alter points selected for the custom settings.
* Custom Look 2 (Moth):  Same as butterfly, but for the moth version.

* Doing a custom setting is 1 alteration service, as is each custom look (so a custom setting, butterfly look, and moth look are 3 separate alterations.  This is because each one is fairly intricate).
* The base/material can be done by a merchant separately or at the same time as one of the custom alterations.
*  It is up to the individual merchant if they wish to work on these items.

raw: Firmly wedged at the top of the length of the mesille is a crystalline spheroid.  It has a small enchanter's glyph.  A strange necrotic haze radiates from the runestaff.
Analysis of an ebon-hued mesille runestaff carved with screaming faces indicates the creator has provided the following information:

This is the Globus Elanthias runestaff, or more commonly the Soul Eater runestaff.  It has spectral shapes as its flare type.  There is a spheroid made of crystalline that is wedged into the top of the length of mesille, and it can be customized in the following way:
Globe Type: Globe, Orb, Sphere, Spheroid, Ball, Skull
Globe Material: Glaesine, Glass, Crystalline, Obsidian, Clear Gemstone

An ebon-hued mesille runestaff carved with screaming faces can be altered with a long or a show description.  If it has a long description, then it will always have a show of "Firmly wedged at the top of the length of mesille is a crystalline spheroid."  However, if it does not have a show description, then it will always have a show of "Sinew and rawhide bind the top of the length of mesille to create a cradle for a crystalline spheroid that rests within it."  If you are designing your own show, you may ask your alterer to include how the spheroid is wedged into the runestaff, but it must always be at the top.
It is currently 4 of 4 Tiers.
With the following verbs available: Attend*, Bow, Chuckle, Clean, Gaze**, Greet, Nudge, Point, Prod, Raise, Rub***, Tap****, and Wave
You have unlocked the Soul Eating feature, which will charge your runestaff.  You can only charge it with creatures that you can learn from.  Some creatures will give more charges than others.
The runestaff currently has 2 charges out of 200 stored in it.

Your carved mesille runestaff will produce a second flare during combat that costs 15 charges at activation.  This option can be toggled on using PROD. (Please note, second flare is an additional seed added to the damage, not unique messaging.
* This is a feature change (hair) option that will last 1 hour and cost 5 charges to activate.
** This is a feature change (eyes) option that will last 1 hour and cost 5 charges to activate.
*** This is a feature change (unique) option that will last 1 hour and cost 5 charges to activate.

There are several customization fields still missing from this piece of flypaper, however, a talented merchant can continue to work on the tattoo once it is on your body.
The following customizations are in place for a thin piece of flypaper:
Base Tattoo: (awaiting an article - you can not tattoo yourself without this field) (awaiting an adjective - you can not tattoo yourself without this field) tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: (awaiting your design)
Show Description Tattoo: (awaiting your design)
Location of Tattoo: Back (this can be changed using FLIP)
The Customized Verbs are:
(Clench): "Bunching your shoulders, the muscles in your back ripple, causing the (awaiting your design) of your  tattoo to appear more pronounced."
(Rub): "You trace (awaiting your design) within the  tattoo on your back."

(Slap):  "You slap your  tattoo, the sting briefly reminding you of the burn of the tattooing process.  In that instance, you think about when (awaiting your design) first graced your golden brown flesh and how it felt when the ink was injected."
(Stretch):  "You give a mighty stretch, the movement highlighting (awaiting your design) of your  tattoo."
(Tap):  "You lightly tap your  tattoo to draw attention to (awaiting your design) at its center."
(Touch):  "You trace the edges of your  tattoo, carefully highlighting (awaiting your design) inked near its lower edge."
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your  tattoo.  If you do, then they will appear as part of TOUCH.  However, you are not required to create a slogan.

raw: This otter-inked flypaper was designed by Flypaper Tattoo Designers.  It will allow you to tattoo your body and will give you special messaging for certain actions taken against the tattoo.
This particular flypaper is fully customized and ready to be placed on your body.  You may FLIP it until you find a suitable location for the tattoo, or RAISE it to tattoo yourself.
The following customizations are in place for a blue piece of otter-inked flypaper:
Base Tattoo: a pair of rotund otters tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: a pair of rotund brown otters tattoo

Show Description Tattoo: Floating upon a pile of bright emerald kelp, a chubby chocolate brown otter barely stays above the blue-green waters of the vibrant pond inked on the golden brown skin.  A taller, less-rotund otter lays next to its companion, the duo's paws entwined around a particularly colorful rock.  Peeking from beneath the strands of green kelp are various koi fish, their mottled white and orange scales distinct in the crystal clear waters.
Location of Tattoo: Back (this can be changed using FLIP)
The Customized Verbs are:
(Clench): "Bunching your shoulders, the muscles in your back ripple, causing the very rounded belly of the chocolate brown otter of your rotund otters tattoo to appear more pronounced."
(Rub): "You trace the smooth lines of the colorful rock within the rotund otters tattoo on your back."

(Slap):  "You slap your rotund otters tattoo, the sting briefly reminding you of the burn of the tattooing process.  In that instance, you think about when the tangled strand of vibrant green kelp first graced your golden brown flesh and how it felt when the ink was injected."
(Stretch):  "You give a mighty stretch, the movement highlighting the ethereal watercolor-like detailing of your rotund otters tattoo."
(Tap):  "You lightly tap your rotund otters tattoo to draw attention to the duo's entwined paws covered in droplets of blue-green water at its center."
(Touch):  "You trace the edges of your rotund otters tattoo, carefully highlighting a curious trio of mottled white and orange koi inked near its lower edge."
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your rotund otters tattoo.  If you do, then they will appear as part of TOUCH.  However, you are not required to create a slogan.

items.name: a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric

raw: The baldric is constructed of layers of storm grey suede and looks like it would be worn cross-torso from shoulder to hip.  Four rows of two faceted glyphs form the baldric's central design, with each ensconced in its own gold setting.  One of the uppermost six glyphs glows a bright blue, while the remaining glyphs in the top three rows are lit by a dim inner light.
It is estimated that a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric can store a small amount with enough space for a couple of items.
Analysis of a gold-stitched storm grey ivory-adorned baldric indicates the creator has provided the following information:

Looking over the baldric and inspecting its finer details, you realize that it will always need to be "a/n (whatever)/ivory-adorned/baldric or yoke".  This means the item's article CAN be changed.  Only "baldric" and "yoke" are valid as nouns, and the adjective of "ivory-adorned" is unalterable.  Also, the allowed wear-locations are shoulder-worn for baldrics and front-worn for yokes.  So if your alteration involves changing the noun, realize the wear-location MUST BE changed also.

NOTE:  The script's description of the baldric refers to it as "Constructed of layers of (color) (material)..." and bearing "...rows of faceted glyphs...," so keep that in mind if you request an alteration.  The material and color of the baldric CAN be changed.  This item cannot accept a SHOW description, since the script already utilizes that field.
The color that the charged glyphs glow CAN be changed.  It must be no longer than fifteen characters.
If you were to play with the ivory-adorned baldric, then you'd find that you can analyze, wear, remove, clench, push, and rub it.  RUB releases/casts a charge previously stored from a white crystal.
This is a Tier 3 baldric, with four tiers in total.  This baldric is sold OTS with one tier unlocked.
SCRIPT NAME: Ivory Adorned Baldric
This baldric CANNOT be deepened at all.

A beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs is part of the Shield Cape Collection, which was purchased at Duskruin in the shop "Shield Thyself".  It is a passive defense item that has a chance to block an incoming blow.  The chance increases with each tier that is unlocked.  If the wearer has no weapons in his hands, no shield/runestaff, or is using a bow/crossbow, then he gets the full benefit of the cape.  Otherwise the chance is halved.
Its current status is OTS and that gives it access to the following verbs: pull (removes brooch), push (adds brooch), remove, turn (removes bangle), twist (adds bangle), wear
To upgrade its abilities, you will need to obtain an unlock certificate.

Brooch Data: (Brooch is Absent) A copper and boar tusk cloak pin can be changed by using PULL to remove the brooch and PUSH to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized brooches will work.  Once your brooch is upgraded from the default piece, it unlocks a 50% chance to retain a charge within it for each successful block.  When the brooch reaches 10 charges, it automatically flares and absorbs all of the charges.

Bangle Data: (Bangle is absent) A polished tortoise shell bangle can be changed by using TURN to remove the bangle and TWIST to add a new one.  Please note, only specialized bangles will work.  Once your bangle is upgraded from the default piece, it provides an additional 25% chance to absorb a charge.  It will not provide this additional percentage chance if the brooch is not upgraded.  Additionally, bangles can have special unlocks to change the flare type.
There are currently 0 charges stored in this beige dagswain cape.

You may alter a beige dagswain cape with red-stitched geometric designs freely providing it does not contradict the messaging.  The cape can never be a jacket, a longcoat, a coat, a robe, or any similar nouns based on its design.  Nor will it ever have a hood.  This garment will attach at the left wrist by a bangle, slide over the arm and across the left shoulder. ---- Animalistic Spirit Armor ----
=General Script Information=
This is armor with the spirit of an animal trapped within it.
The spirit is wild and must be tamed by unleashing attacks against like-level foes, or successfully evading them during combat.
If not fully tame, the spirit within can backlash upon the owner.
Allegiance can be changed, but the new owner must work off the trust gained by the previous owner.
When the wearer is hit, the armor has a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct, which can knockdown the attacker and disorient them momentarily.
If used with an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and also add the weapon/shield's Animalistic Fury flares to the response.
=Alteration Guidelines=
* Alterations to the 15/15/15, long and show of this armor are fine.
* Any merchant can change the associated Armor Accents to match the alteration.
* Some merchants can change the spirit color, spirit call, spirit group, or how the spirit looks.
NOTE: You cannot change the general type of animal, such as changing a large feline to be a canine, except using certificates.
As well, each spirit type only has certain pre-approved nouns allowed.
=Features=
* Animalistic Instinct Flares (Tier 4 of 4)
The spirit within lashes out defensively with a maneuver-based sonic attack, causing knockdown and roundtime.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield, there is a chance the armor will call for aid and will add Animalistic Fury flares.
Flares are currently: ON [RUB to toggle]
* Revenge Flares = Unlocked
On a successful evade, there is a chance to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares.  You must be in a forward or greater stance and be an active combatant in combat for the spirit to react.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
If you wield an Animalistic Spirit weapon or shield with Revenge unlocked, there is a chance the armor will call for aid to add Animalistic Fury flares.
* Bestial Barrier = Unlocked

NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Feral Whirlwind = Locked
Once an hour, direct the spirit within to unleash Animalistic Instinct flares against 3 to 5 creatures in the room in a single sonic attack by STOMPing the chain.
NOTE: Power of this ability is tied to the Flare tier.
* Untamed Vitality = Locked
Once an hour, draw on the vitality of the spirit within your armor for an increase in a combination of Health, Mana, and/or Stamina Recovery by CLENCHing the chain.
* Flavor Actions (Tier 1 of 3)

Analysis of a reinforced brass still polished to a mirror shine indicates the creator has provided the following information:
-- Alcohol Still --
This brass still will create alcoholic beverages, either brewed or distilled.
This is a basic still, which will require ingredients as well as charges from fire spells or golden wands to function.
In addition, you will need an alcohol recipe book to be able to select recipes to create with this still.

Food, foraged items, tea/coffee flavorings, and other items can be added to the still during the creation process to infuse extra flavoring into the finished product.  You can only add up to two (2) of these extra flavorings, but they are not required.
These extra flavorings will also affect the color of the resulting liquid.
==Alteration Guidelines==
* Alterations to the 15/15/15 and long description of this brass still are fine, but it cannot accept a show.
* The noun must remain "still" and it must be made primarily of metal.

* The article of the created alcohol can be customized, but it must be a large container that could feasibly hold alcohol.  Examples: "a bottle of", "a jug of".  This can't be longer than 15 characters.

* The created alcohol can have a long description, but there must be an open spot for the adjective, as this can differ from distillation to distillation.  Example: a bottle of (adjective) (alcohol noun) with a peeling gold label.
* The created alcohol can also have a show description as well as an inscription (READ) in any language.
* The material of the alcohol's container, as well as the top/cork, can also be customized; these are mainly used in messaging.
* Any willing merchant that is comfortable with this script can customize all of the above.
* NOTE: Altering the still itself counts as a service, while altering how the  created alcohol looks is a completely separate service.
==Features==

As a basic still, you have access to the following verbs: DROP/POUR (add ingredients/flavorings), CLEAN (empty still of in progress work), FLIP (change adjective of produced alcohol), PUSH (create alcohol).
Add golden wands to the still or cast fire spells at it to charge its power.
Adding more water to the still will weaken the resulting alcohol.
POINT an accompanying recipe book at this still to select a type of alcohol to begin making.
INSPECT the still to get an overview of how the alcohol will appear as well as where you are in the process.

WHISPER to the brass still with a potential ingredient in your hand to send it in for review.  Please be sure to include text indicating if it is not working for a specific recipe or if it's just not allowed as a flavor.
Possible alcohol effects: None.
==Current Settings==
* Alcohol 15/15/15: a bottle of,(adjective),(alcohol noun)
* Alcohol Container Material: glass [Default]
* Alcohol Container Noun: bottle [Default]
* Alcohol Container Top: cork [Default]

This device works all across the seas of Elanthia and allows you to look at all the lovely sea creatures that the waters have to offer.  Once you've captured the likeness of one, the device lets you imbue them with magic.  This magic lets you transfer designs featuring the little critters to paper.
Instructions:
1. GAZE through the device as you wander the various seas and oceans
2. WAVE the device when you find a sea critter you'd like to capture the likeness of
3. SHAKE the sea critter out of the device to retrieve it
You may look at the device at any time to see what, if anything, is inside it.
Once you have a sea critter inside, you have a few options.
OPTIONS:
1. WHISPER MY device OPTION PAPER - Paper is the default, but if you move away it will get you back.
2. WHISPER MY device OPTION GEM   - This will let you transform your critter into a gemstone.
3. WHISPER MY device OPTION CANDY {hard or chew or chocolate} - This will transform your critter into one of the specified candy types.
The device is currently 3 of 3 Tiers.
Alterations: You may alter the device provided it stays some kind of glass, tube-like device.  Noun can be tube or device or cylinder.
The tubular device will cost 15,000,000 coins.

This blue waxpaper was designed by Pigments of Memory.  It will allow you to tattoo your body and will give you special messaging based on who the tattoo has been created in memory of.
There are several customization fields still missing from this blue waxpaper, however, a talented merchant can continue to work on the tattoo once it is on your body.
The following customizations are in place for a piece of blue waxpaper:
Base Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) (Awaiting your Design - Max 15 Characters) tattoo
Long Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Show Description Tattoo: (Awaiting your Design)
Location of Tattoo: Thigh (this can be changed using FLIP)
Your Pigments of Memory tattoo is designed for a lover.  You have created the following customizations for it:
Your Lover's Name is (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
Your Lover is a giantman (this can be changed using TWIST).
Your Lover is male (this can be changed using SPIN).
Your Lover has (Awaiting Eye Color - What is the eye color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) eyes.
Your Lover has (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
A phrase you shared with your Lover is "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)"
A favorite setting of you and your Lover is (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).
An emotional trigger for you and your Lover is (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?).
When you use the following verbs, this is how your memories will play out:

(Touch) - You brush your fingers against (tattoo), following the curve of the giantman's face towards his temple, and close your eyes as if remembering running your fingers through his (Awaiting Hair Color - What is the hair color of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) hair.
(Gaze) - You glance at your (tattoo), your lips quirking at a half-memory of similar shared glances.

(Cover) - You lay your hand over your (tattoo), your eyes slipping closed as a momentary pang of mourning fills you.  That pain is suddenly eased by the memory of his smile, and for a brief moment, you could swear you feel his hand upon yours once again.

(Tickle) - You trace the lines of your (tattoo), your mind wandering to a memory of a time that you and (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) were (Awaiting Setting - Where did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body visit?).  You can almost feel his lips at your ear as he whispers, "(Awaiting Phrase - What phrase did you and the person you are having tattooed on your body share?)."

(Sob) - As you glance at (Awaiting Trigger - What causes you to think of the person you are having tattooed on your body?), you feel your throat suddenly constrict as you are reminded that (Awaiting Name - What is the name of the person you are having tattooed on your body?) is no longer at your side.  You absently lay your hand upon your (tattoo), drawing strength in the fact that you have many, many good memories to draw upon.
Slogan: You may have words or phrases as part of your  tattoo.  If you do, then it will appear only when the tattoo is read.
The waxpaper can not be worn.

Welcome to Pigments of Memory waxpaper.  The waxpaper will allow you to tattoo your body and give you a special series of customizations for that tattoo.  You may FLIP it to switch the place that you want the tattoo to appear.  You may SPIN it to switch the gender of the portrait.  You may also twist to change the race of the portrait.  Once you have settled your options, you may RAISE it to gain the tattoo.
To see the special tattoo that a piece of blue waxpaper will create, please READ it.
Special Alteration Instructions:

Some tattoo artists have permission to alter the waxpaper, but not all.  Please note, that once on the body, the tattoo cannot be modified, so it is important to have the waxpaper completely modified before raising.
